en: SCTV: The Greatest Show You've Never Heard Of
plotEn: SCTV: The Greatest Show You've Never Heard Of is a 2026 American documentary film, directed by Jason Hehir, about the sketch comedy television show SCTV. The film was released on Netflix on October 30, 2026.
